dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Inazuma's not such a bad place, Paimon's having a pretty good time! But... we should probably go and see about the "next operation" that Thoma and Ayaka were talking about, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As usual, it's the first stop, Komore Teahouse. Are you ready to head over?
